title: Orthogonal projections in the local Dirichlet spaces
summary: We present an explicit formula for the orthogonal projection onto the subspace of analytic polynomials of degree at most $n$ in the local Dirichlet space $D_μ$ , where the positive measure $μ$ consists of a finite number of Dirac measures located at points on the unit circle $\mathbb T$. This result has two key aspects: first, while it is known that polynomials are dense in $D_μ$ , this approach offers a concrete linear approximation scheme within the space.
